dynamic_frames.method: Full official GET/JSON checksums, strict Base64 decode, decoded chunk and concatenated SHA-256/length, every indexed JPEG fully decoded in memory; no downloaded files retained.

index_checks.time_basis: Elapsed acquisition milliseconds encoded in source TIFF filenames; Video playback uses 6 frames/s.
